Duration::fill_nat¶

Back to Duration API Reference

Signature¶

Duration Duration::fill_nat(const Duration& value) const;

What It Does¶

Replaces every missing (Duration::kNaT) position with value, leaving already-valid positions unchanged.

Parameters¶

value (const Duration&)

The replacement for missing positions. Broadcasts against self.

Returns¶

Duration A new duration with every missing position replaced by value.

Examples¶

Example 1. fill_nat replaces the missing value with a real Duration.

auto missing = pluss::duration::nanos(pluss::Duration::kNaT);
auto filled = missing.fill_nat(pluss::duration::hours(2));
std::cout << pluss::duration::print(filled);

Output¶

Duration(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1)
0 days 02:00:00.000000000

missing had no real value (pluss::duration::print(missing) would print NaT); after fill_nat(pluss::duration::hours(2)), it prints as an ordinary 2-hour Duration.

Notes¶

  • Positions that are already valid pass through unchanged — fill_nat never overwrites a real value.

See Also¶

  • isnat: testing for the missing positions this replaces.

  • where: the more general conditional-selection operation fill_nat is a special case of (mask = isnat()).
